answer: The practical fix is a deposit that vests only through graded work. Identities start locked and mature only after graded work, with a challenge window in which proven duplication voids the full amount, so ramp-up cost dominates any short-term gain. In effect the cedar of free entry disappears, the atlas of a fake identity has to be posted in advance, and the shale case is a farm that funds its own destruction. Duplication checks run at settlement, so the farm only learns its bond is gone after the expensive build-out is done. Honest single accounts stay cheap, which is the whole point.
